class.name: VoxelField3D
class.brief_description: Draws a far-field voxel stand-in whose voxel level the GPU picks per brick and frame.
class.description: Draws the voxels of a [VoxelFieldData] as camera-facing discs. Every frame a compute pass picks one level per brick: the coarsest level whose voxels are at most [member voxel_pixels] wide at the brick's nearest point. Near bricks draw fine voxels, far bricks coarse ones, so the splats stay about the same size on screen and the stand-in keeps the look of the meshes it replaces. The pass frustum-culls the splats and writes the visible ones into an indirect [MultiMesh], so Godot's renderer draws them with its usual lighting, fog and depth. Use it like a voxel proxy from [method VoxelProxyBuilder.build]: switch from the source meshes with [member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_begin] on the field and [member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_end] on the source. Outside its visibility range the field selects nothing and skips its compute pass. Splats are selected for the current camera of the field's viewport. Shadows of splats outside its view would be missing, so the field does not cast shadows by default. [b]Note:[/b] Experimental. Needs a RenderingDevice renderer (Forward+ or Mobile); draws nothing with Compatibility.

method.name: get_gpu_memory_usage
method.description: Returns the GPU memory the field uses, in bytes: the instance buffer (80 bytes per splat of capacity) plus the voxel data and parameters.

method.name: get_splat_count
method.description: Returns the number of splats selected in a recent frame, read back asynchronously a few frames late, and at most the instance buffer's capacity. Returns [code]0[/code] before the first result arrives.

method.name: get_splat_material
method.description: Returns the default splat material. A [member GeometryInstance3D.material_override] replaces it; its shader must rebuild the disc the same way (see the default shader's code).

members.member: The voxel levels to draw, in the node's local space.
If [code]true[/code], bricks and splats outside the camera's frustum are not drawn.

Capacity of the instance buffer. With [code]0[/code], it grows with the count the GPU asks for, up to [method VoxelFieldData.get_max_splat_count]; while it grows, for a few frames, only the first splats draw. A fixed capacity drops the splats beyond it.
Largest on-screen voxel width, in pixels, before a brick switches to a finer level. Smaller values look closer to the source meshes and draw more splats.
